story.overview:
As a platform operator, I want Orion to use Anthropic's Tool Search capability for on-demand tool discovery, so that token usage is reduced when many MCP tools are available and the system scales efficiently.
When Orion connects to multiple MCP servers, each server provides many tools. With 100+ tools at ~200 tokens each, passing all tool definitions in every request consumes 20k+ tokens. Tool Search enables lazy loading - tools are marked with defer_loading: true and Claude discovers them on-demand using the built-in tool_search_tool_bm25.
Key Insight: The tool_search_tool_bm25 must be explicitly added to the tools array - it is NOT automatically provided by the API when deferred tools exist.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Given TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED=true (default), When MCP tools are registered, Then non-core tools are annotated with defer_loading: true
Given a model that supports tool search (Sonnet 4.5+, Opus 4.5+), When tools are passed to Claude, Then defer_loading is applied to non-core tools
Given a model that does NOT support tool search (Claude 3.x), When tools are passed to Claude, Then defer_loading is NOT applied and all tools are in context
Given tools configured in CORE_TOOLS env var, Then those tools are never deferred (always in context)
Given tool search is enabled, When deferred tools exist, Then tool_search_tool_bm25 is added to the tools array
Given model doesn't support tool search, Then graceful fallback to all-tools-in-context with warning logged
Given tool search triggers discovery, Then token savings are tracked in Langfuse

dependencies.dependency: Anthropic SDK v0.71.x - tool search beta support

technical-notes.note: | Environment Variable | Default | Description | | TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED | true | Enable/disable tool search feature | | CORE_TOOLS | memory,code_execution,summarize | Comma-separated list of always-loaded tools |

Tool Search requires Sonnet 4.5+ or Opus 4.5+ models: - Supported: /^claude-sonnet-4-/ (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-20250514) - Supported: /^claude-opus-4-/ (e.g., claude-opus-4-20250801) - NOT supported: /^claude-3-/ or /^claude-3-5-/

1. Request: Core tools (always loaded) + MCP tools with defer_loading: true + tool_search_tool_bm25 2. Discovery: Claude uses tool_search_tool_bm25 to discover relevant deferred tools 3. Claude calls: tool_search_tool_bm25 with search query, receives matching tool definitions 4. Execution: Discovered tools called via normal tool_use blocks 5. Processing: Our executeTool handler processes them unchanged

| Tool | Reason | | memory | Auto-context feature requires immediate availability | | code_execution | PTC container lifecycle requires immediate availability | | summarize | Conversation summarization |
- If model doesn't support tool search, falls back to all-tools-in-context - Warning logged when fallback occurs - No user-facing errors from tool search configuration

| Requirement | Implementation | | ESM imports | All imports use .js extension | | Logging | Uses logger.* with traceId | | Config | config.toolSearch.enabled, config.toolSearch.coreTools | | Observability | Langfuse events for token savings |
Story 8.6 addresses a bug: The tool_search_tool_bm25 must be explicitly added to the tools array. Initial implementation may have omitted this, causing tool search to not function.

by-type.happy-path: Model detection, defer_loading annotation, tool_search_tool_bm25 inclusion
by-type.edge-cases: Empty tool lists, large tool counts, model name variations, null/undefined handling
by-type.error-handling: Invalid MCP tools, Langfuse failures, API rejections (2 pending)

file.purpose: defer_loading and core tool logic (AC1, AC4)

relevant-sections.section:
Purpose: Reduce token usage when 100s of MCP tools available by lazy-loading tools on demand.
Beta header required (already in allBetas): advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20
Configure MCP tools for deferred loading: - defer_loading: true on non-core tools - Core tools (memory, web_search, code_execution) always loaded
Model Requirements: - Sonnet 4.5+ (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) or Opus 4.5+ - Older models do not support tool search
Observability: - Track token savings in Langfuse: tool_search.tokens_saved - Log which tools were discovered vs. always loaded

All beta headers consolidated in config.anthropic.allBetas: - context-management-2025-06-27 (Memory tool) - advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20 (PTC + Tool Search) - code-execution-2025-08-25 (Skills execution) - skills-2025-10-02 (Skills API) - files-api-2025-04-14 (File downloads)
Rule: Always use config.anthropic.allBetas in messages.create(). Never construct beta arrays inline.

src/tools/ registry.ts - TOOL_NAMES, handlers, getToolsForClaude() memory/ - Anthropic Memory Tool mcp/ - MCP Client (manager, discovery, servers) code-execution/ - GKE sandbox fallback search/ - Knowledge search tools

patterns-to-follow.pattern: Feature toggles via environment.ts: config.toolSearch.enabled - boolean config.toolSearch.coreTools - string[]

Create dedicated model-capabilities.ts module with: - supportsToolSearch(model: string): boolean - getModelCapabilities(model: string): ModelCapabilities Pattern match on model ID prefixes (claude-sonnet-4-, claude-opus-4-)

When feature not supported: 1. Log warning with event name 2. Fall back to working alternative 3. No user-facing errors
logger.warn({ event: 'tool_search.fallback', model, reason: 'Model does not support tool search' });
All imports use .js extension for ESM compatibility: import { supportsToolSearch } from './model-capabilities.js';
